n_coins_left = input().split()
n = int(n_coins_left[0])
coins_left = int(n_coins_left[1])
vals = list(map(int, input().split()))

odd_count = 0
even_count = 0
cuts_count = 0
diff_list = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    current_val = vals[i]
    if current_val % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1
    if odd_count == even_count:
        next_val = vals[i + 1]
        diff = abs(next_val - current_val)
        diff_list.append(diff)

diff_list.sort()

for d in diff_list:
    if d <= coins_left:
        coins_left -= d
        cuts_count += 1
    else:
        break

print(cuts_count)
</translated_code>
